name: Echo bot
author: ModuForge
description: A Telegram bot that repeats what you write to it. Asks for the bot token once; /start, /help and /count are commands, everything else is echoed back.

permissionReasons.FILE_SANDBOXED: Keeps the bot token and the message counter.
permissionReasons.BACKGROUND_EXECUTION: Keeps answering while the app is not on screen.
